problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting cargo containers to load onto a freight truck. The available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 43kg, revenue 231 dollars
* Container 2: weight 21kg, revenue 156 dollars
* Container 3: weight 2kg, revenue 43 dollars
* Container 4: weight 30kg, revenue 150 dollars
* Container 5: weight 41kg, revenue 205 dollars
* Container 6: weight 14kg, revenue 92 dollars
* Container 7: weight 47kg, revenue 241 dollars
* Container 8: weight 1kg, revenue 90 dollars
* Container 9: weight 1kg, revenue 95 dollars
* Container 10: weight 37kg, revenue 35 dollars
* Container 11: weight 6kg, revenue 199 dollars
* Container 12: weight 50kg, revenue 37 dollars
* Container 13: weight 43kg, revenue 124 dollars
* Container 14: weight 15kg, revenue 264 dollars
* Container 15: weight 17kg, revenue 169 dollars
* Container 16: weight 37kg, revenue 201 dollars
* Container 17: weight 48kg, revenue 284 dollars
* Container 18: weight 21kg, revenue 264 dollars
* Container 19: weight 40kg, revenue 268 dollars
* Container 20: weight 50kg, revenue 35 dollars
* Container 21: weight 16kg, revenue 76 dollars
* Container 22: weight 48kg, revenue 119 dollars
* Container 23: weight 15kg, revenue 60 dollars

The truck has a maximum weight capacity of 450 kg. Determine which containers to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
